cohort: The study included 31 published reports and 7 new cases of umbilical cord ulceration (UCU) with perinatal hemorrhage in the setting of congenital duodenal or jejunal obstruction.
finding: Umbilical cord ulceration with perinatal hemorrhage is associated with duodenal and jejunal obstruction, leading to high rates of complications like preterm labor, fetal distress, and significant mortality (32% neonatal deaths, 32% intrauterine deaths).
gest_age: Mean gestational age was 33 weeks, with 95% of cases being premature gestation.
